mentions.name: Feisty Duck's Cryptography & Security News
mentions.description: A curated news aggregator focused on tracking how cryptography is evolving, monitoring and amplifying the people on the ground doing actual cryptography and security work. The front page is a curated low-volume stream, with an additional all-news feed. It was built after 12+ years of producing Feisty Duck's Newsletter to make following cryptography events easier.
mentions.problem: Following cryptography news and events is difficult to keep up with; the aggregator was built to make following events easier.
mentions.audience: People interested in following cryptography and security news; built for the author's own use but made public as it may be useful to others.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Feisty Duck's Cryptography & Security News: https://www.feistyduck.com/news/

It's a news aggregator focused on furthering our understanding of how cryptography is evolving. We're aiming to monitor the people on the ground who are doing the actual work, and amplify them.

The front page is a curated low-volume stream, but there's an all-news feed as well.
